_README: TAXI FARES.
Two kinds of number in here, and they are not interchangeable:
privateUSD / privateMaxUSD    the WHOLE CAR
colectivoUSD / colectivoMaxUSD  PER PERSON in a shared taxi
The airport rows are the rate card posted at the terminal: a fixed
price for the car, up to four passengers, 06:00-18:00. Those are the
only fares on the island anyone actually publishes, which is why they
are the only ones recorded as exact numbers rather than ranges.
Everything else came from the 'gettingThere' lines in areas.json and
the cruise guides — Josh's own copy, already shipping. Those are all
ranges, and they are only recorded in the SHARED column where the
original said '/person'. Where it didn't, the fare stays null rather
than being guessed into a column: telling colectivo from privado is
the point of this screen, and a per-car price in the per-person column
would do more harm than a blank.
Josh corrected Town Center port to West Bay to $10-15. He lives here;
he outranks the file.
A route with no fare at all never renders, and the screen hides
entirely if no route has one. Safe to ship half-filled.
TRAVEL TIMES. The thirteen routes below were mapped by Josh in Google
Maps and are used exactly as measured, not modelled:
Mahogany Bay to West Bay 30, to West End 30. Town Center port to
West Bay 15, to West End 15. Coxen Hole to Sandy Bay 10, to French
Harbour 20. West Bay to Coxen Hole 20, French Harbour 35, Flowers
Bay 8, Mahogany Bay 30, Town Center port 15. West End to Sandy Bay
5, to Coxen Hole 20.
Everything else — the airport runs and the east end — is still
computed: median business coordinates per area, distance measured
ALONG the one island road rather than point to point, and minutes
fitted to reported drive times. Those stay as ranges. The measured
ones are single numbers because they were actually measured.
The measured times corrected a pricing error, which is the more
useful thing they did. West Bay to Flowers Bay was written up as a
25-minute run at $10-15 a head. It is 8 minutes. The fare had been
set to match a distance that was wrong, so it is now $5-8 like every
other short hop.
One oddity, left alone deliberately: Mahogany Bay to West Bay is 30
minutes at $5-8 a head, while Town Center port to West Bay is 15
minutes at $10-15. Twice the drive for half the fare. Both numbers
are Josh's. Mahogany is a high-volume cruise port running shuttle
vans, which is the likely reason, but it is not confirmed and the
figures stand as given rather than being smoothed into a curve.
STILL OPEN: the run back TO the airport (the posted card only governs
taxis leaving it), and private rates for anything that isn't an airport
run or the West Bay/West End hop.
source: the airport's posted rate card and our own island guides
rules: No meters anywhere on the island. Agree the fare before you get in — every time, even for a run you did yesterday.
Say which one you want. A colectivo is a shared seat priced per person; a privado is the whole car. Being quoted the car price for what turns out to be a shared seat is how visitors overpay here.
Airport fares are posted at the terminal and fixed: one price for the car, up to four people, 6am to 6pm. Outside those hours — or from the road rather than the rank — you're negotiating again.
A colectivo along the main road is about 45–50 lempiras, under two dollars. If you're quoted five or eight dollars for a seat, that's the visitor price and it's worth asking.
The water taxi between West End and West Bay is $5 a head once there are three of you in the boat, and $10 each if it's just one or two. Five minutes, and usually quicker than going round by road.
If a driver is having a slow day, or is already heading your way, there's often a deal in it — the road and water taxis both compete for the same fare. Ask.
Hiring a driver for the day runs roughly $25–30 a head for a group, which usually beats three or four separate runs.
Carry small bills. Dollars work as well as lempiras, but drivers often can't break a twenty.
